Containment Tenure

  • CURIE: gmeow:ContainmentTenure
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ContainmentTenure
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The reified, time-scoped fact that a place was contained in a larger place over an interval — for boundary changes, re-organisations, and disputed parallel parents. Reifies containedInPlace over time; the plain transitive property remains the flat shortcut.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:TimeScopedRelation

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:ContainmentTenure as a specialized kind of gmeow:TimeScopedRelation. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
